placeholders.{objectTypeId.household}: objectTypeId in the response of the create-schema request for this object (schemas.json).
placeholders.{objectTypeId.advice_case}: objectTypeId in the response of the create-schema request for this object (schemas.json).

body.name: household
body.description: A client unit, one person or a couple or family, that the practice advises together. Holds the service terms, risk profile and review dates. People link to it, so each human keeps one record.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Household name, for example the family name followed by household.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.household}.

body.name: advice_case
body.description: One piece of advice work for a household, from fact find to recommendation to products placed. This is the delivery of advice and stays apart from the deal that won the client.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Household name and the advice topic, for example retirement planning.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.advice_case}.

body.name: review
body.description: One scheduled review of a household's plan, usually yearly. Tracks the invitation, the meeting and the follow-up actions so no household goes unreviewed.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Household name and review year, for example the family name 2027 review.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.review}.
